user.title: IKEA BILRESA dimmer
user.description: Choose the dimmer (the Matter device with nine buttons).

lights.title: Lights of each mode
lights.description: Turning the wheel dims or brightens these lights and pressing it switches them on or off. The mode button switches between the three modes. A mode with no lights does nothing.

error.not_a_dimmer: This device does not have the nine buttons of a BILRESA dimmer.

abort.already_configured: This dimmer is already set up.
abort.no_fast_matter_switch: Set up Fast Matter switch first.
